# Semantic mutants of the proved functions (scripts/mutants.sh): package,
# function, the text replaced in the package's source, its replacement.
# Each mutant must fail the Go property test of its package and leave at
# least one goal of its function unproved with the saved proofs.
proofs|Max2|return b|return a
proofs|Max3|return Max2(Max2(a, b), c)|return Max2(a, b)
invariants|CountPositive|n++|n += 2
invariants|IndexOf|return i|return i + 1
invariants|AllNonNeg|x < 0|x < -1
invariants|Fill|xs[i] = v|xs[i] = v + 1
loops|Clamp|return lo|return lo - 1
loops|ClampAll|xs[i] = Clamp(xs[i], lo, hi)|xs[i] = Clamp(xs[i], lo, hi) + 1
loops|HasDuplicate|j := i + 1|j := i
loops|BubbleSort|a[j] > a[j+1]|a[j] < a[j+1]
strloops|FirstByte|return int(s[0])|return int(s[0]) + 256
strloops|CountByte|n++|n += 2
